label: Telegram

tools.name: GetChat
tools.description:
Get metadata about a Telegram chat, group, or channel.

Returns information including the chat type, title, description, and member count.
The bot must be a member of the chat to retrieve its information.

parameters.name: chat_id
parameters.description: The numeric chat ID or group ID.

tools.name: ReceiveButtonPress
tools.description:
Resume waiting for an inline-button tap on a message that was already sent with buttons.

Use this only to keep waiting after an earlier attempt's wait window elapsed without a tap — it
does NOT send anything. It is a bounded long-poll on Telegram's getUpdates: it waits a short
window for a tap on the given message, and when one happens the toolkit acknowledges it and
collapses the keyboard to the chosen option (no agent round-trip), returning the choice as
selected_option. If the window elapses with no tap, it returns timed_out=true with a
next_offset cursor to resume from again.

Cannot be used while the bot has an active webhook, because getUpdates and webhooks are
mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: chat_id
parameters.description: The numeric chat ID where the buttoned message was sent.

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.description: The message_id of the buttoned message to keep watching for a tap, as returned when the message was sent.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Update ID cursor to resume from: pass the next_offset from the prior response. WARNING: advancing the cursor permanently confirms (removes) all updates with a lower update ID across all chats. Defaults to 0, which starts a fresh wait.

tools.name: ReceiveMessages
tools.description:
Receive the messages a private chat sent the bot that it hasn't received yet.

This is built on Telegram's getUpdates. Messages already waiting come back at once, oldest
first; when none is waiting, it waits up to timeout_seconds for one to arrive. Returned
messages are acknowledged, so later calls don't return them again, and updates from other
chats that the read passes over are acknowledged and dropped too. has_more is true when more
updates may be waiting: call again with next_offset to read them. If nothing arrives in time,
it returns an empty message list with timed_out set to true and a next_offset to keep waiting
from.

Returns messages from private (1:1) chats only — group and channel messages are excluded for
security, since any group member could inject content. This tool cannot be used while the bot
has an active webhook, because getUpdates and webhooks are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: chat_id
parameters.description: Return messages from the private chat with this numeric chat ID. Messages from other chats are skipped.

parameters.name: timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Wait up to this many seconds for a message when none is waiting, then return a timed-out result. Maximum is 25, and 0 checks once without waiting. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Update ID cursor to resume from: pass the next_offset from a previous response. WARNING: advancing the cursor permanently confirms (removes) all updates with a lower update ID across all chats. Defaults to 0, which starts from the oldest update the bot hasn't received yet.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of updates to read from Telegram per check (1-100). Fewer messages may come back, because non-message updates and messages from other chats are skipped. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: SendMessage
tools.description:
Send a text message to a Telegram chat, group, or channel.

The bot must be a member of the target chat or have permission to send messages to the
specified channel.

When the message asks the recipient a question, prefer attaching the possible answers as inline
`buttons` rather than asking in free text. With buttons and wait_for_response (the default),
this call waits for the user to tap one and returns it as `selected_option` — the toolkit
collapses the keyboard to the choice automatically, so you do not react to the tap yourself. If
no tap arrives in the wait window, `timed_out` is true and `next_offset` lets you resume waiting
without re-sending. Reserve a plain (button-less) message for statements or genuinely
open-ended questions.

parameters.name: chat_id
parameters.description: The numeric chat ID to send the message to.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text content of the message to send.

parameters.name: parse_mode
parameters.description: How to format the message text. Defaults to PLAIN.

parameters.name: disable_notification
parameters.description: Send the message silently without a notification sound. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: buttons
parameters.description: A list of answer options to present as tappable inline buttons below the message (one per row). STRONGLY PREFER this whenever the message asks a question with a known set of answers (confirmations, yes/no, or any multiple-choice) — it turns the reply into a single tap instead of free-form text. Each label must be at most 64 bytes. Leave it out only for a statement or a genuinely open-ended question that needs a free-text answer. Defaults to no buttons.

parameters.name: wait_for_response
parameters.description: When the message has buttons, wait for the user to tap one and return the chosen option as selected_option in this same call (the toolkit collapses the keyboard to the choice automatically — you do not react to the tap yourself). Has no effect when there are no buttons. If no tap arrives within the wait window, the result has timed_out=true with a next_offset cursor to resume waiting from. Defaults to true.

text.value: Would you like to confirm your appointment for tomorrow at 10:00 AM?

tools.name: SendTtsAudio
tools.description:
Convert text to speech using OpenAI TTS and send it as an audio message on Telegram.

Generates an MP3 audio file from the provided text using OpenAI's text-to-speech API,
then sends it to the specified Telegram chat.

parameters.name: chat_id
parameters.description: The numeric chat ID to send the audio to.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text to convert to speech and send as an audio message. Maximum 4096 characters (after stripping leading/trailing whitespace).

parameters.name: voice
parameters.description: The voice to use for text-to-speech. Defaults to ALLOY.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: Playback speed multiplier (0.25-4.0). 1.0 is normal speed, higher is faster. Defaults to 1.0.

parameters.name: instructions
parameters.description: Style or tone instructions for the voice (e.g., 'speak in a cheerful tone'). Defaults to an empty string, which uses the voice's standard style.

parameters.name: disable_notification
parameters.description: Send the audio silently without a notification sound. Defaults to false.

text.value: Hello! Welcome to our daily news briefing. Today's top stories include advancements in renewable energy and new developments in space exploration.

instructions.value: speak in a calm and professional tone

tools.name: WhoAmI
tools.description:
Get information about the Telegram bot.

Returns the bot's identity including its ID, username, and capabilities.

summary:
Arcade toolkit for building bots on Telegram. Enables LLMs to send messages, poll for replies, handle inline-button interactions, retrieve chat metadata, and deliver TTS audio — all via a Telegram bot identity.

## Capabilities

- **Bot identity & chat inspection:** Retrieve the bot's own profile and capabilities, or fetch metadata (type, title, description, member count) for any chat, group, or channel the bot has joined.
- **Messaging:** Send text messages to any chat, group, or channel the bot can access; attach inline buttons to structured questions and optionally block until the user taps one.
- **Long-poll message receiving:** Read unacknowledged messages from private 1:1 chats via `getUpdates`; supports pagination with `next_offset`, bounded wait windows, and `timed_out` signals for resuming. Group/channel messages are excluded for security.
- **Inline-button resumption:** Resume waiting for a button tap on a previously sent message without re-sending it; bounded long-poll acknowledges the tap and collapses the keyboard automatically.
- **Text-to-speech audio:** Convert text to speech via OpenAI TTS (MP3) and deliver it as an audio message in a Telegram chat.

> **Note:** `getUpdates`-based tools (`ReceiveMessages`, `ReceiveButtonPress`) are mutually exclusive with Telegram webhooks — the bot must not have an active webhook when using them.

## Secrets

`TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` — The authentication token for your Telegram bot. Create a bot by messaging [@BotFather](https://t.me/botfather) on Telegram and sending `/newbot`. BotFather will issue a token in the format `123456789:ABCdef...`. This token authenticates all API calls made on behalf of the bot and should be kept private. See the [Telegram Bot API docs](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#authorizing-your-bot) for details.

`OPENAI_API_KEY` — An OpenAI API key used to call the TTS endpoint (`tts-1` or similar model) when generating audio with `SendTtsAudio`. Generate one in the [OpenAI API keys dashboard](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys) under your OpenAI account. The key must belong to an account with access to the Audio/TTS API; usage is billed to that account.

Store both secrets in Arcade via https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets (or manage them at https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets).
